test_stimuli.name: porta_all_high_portb_all_low
test_stimuli.derivation: porta_byte=0xFF: each bit (0..7) is 1; portb_byte=0x00: each bit is 0.

test_stimuli.name: porta_mixed_portb_mixed
test_stimuli.derivation: porta_byte=0x55: bits 0,2,4,6=1; bits 1,3,5,7=0. portb_byte=0xAA: bits 0,2,4,6=0; bits 1,3,5,7=1.

test_stimuli.name: porta_zero_portb_zero
test_stimuli.derivation: Both port bytes are 0x00, so all bits are 0.
